name: [GRAND PATCH] Heroes: Online World
desc:
Heroes: Online World is an adventerous open world game. You can fight battles and become anyone you want. Be a HERO or VILLAIN. The path is yours to walk. 

⭐ Fight players with special powers
⭐ Earn coins to unlock new characters or skins
⭐ Find unique chests in-game to claim rewards
⭐ New characters and skins are added every month
⭐ Be a HERO or a VILLAIN
💰Complete QUESTS to earn a lot of coins

🔥 Join our social link below to join our Community or report bugs/exploiters
🛠️We are adding new characters, updates, bug fixes every week! 
👍 If you like the game, don't forget to thumbs up!
